mLocKeys.keySummary: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lucian dashes.

Cooldown is reduced by @Effect1Amount@ second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger (@Effect2Amount@ seconds for champions).
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Lucian can use other Abilities while dashing.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
After using an Ability, Lucian's next Attack within @PassiveDuration@ seconds will fire two shots. The second shot deals @TotalDamage@ physical damage to the target, increased to @MinionDamage@ against minions.

Vigilance: When Lucian is directly healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is Immobilized, his pistols become Overcharged with energy, causing his next @NumAuto@ basic attacks to deal an additional @PassiveTotalDamage@ magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{ Spell_LucianPassive_Tooltip }}
Vigilance can store up to @MaxAutos@ empowered basic attacks.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Lightslinger</titleLeft><mainText>Lucian's next basic attack will be a double-shot.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
OverchargedLucian's pistols are infused with additional energy from his allies, causing his basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage. Source: @SourceName@

LightslingerAfter completing every spell cast, Lucian's next basic attack within 3 seconds will be a double-shot.

The second shot deals @f1@ damage to enemy champions and structures, and applies on-hit effects. Minions take full damage from the second shot.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability's cast time decreases with Lucian's level.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lucian rapidly fires @TotalNumShots@ shots in a direction for @Duration@ seconds or until he Recasts. Each shot deals @DamagePerBullet@ physical damage to the first enemy hit.

While firing, Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit.

Total Damage: @TotalDamage@ physical damage
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Number of shots scales with Lucian's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike damage at @CritValueMod*100@% effectiveness.
Deals @PercentDamageAmpToMinions@% damage to minions.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lucian fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage, briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds.

When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains @Effect2Amount@ Move Speed for 1 second. Allies triggering this effect will also grant Lucian Vigilance.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ardent Blaze</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been marked with Ardent Blaze. Lucian gains Move Speed for damaging this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
